### It’s Later Than You Think
Author: Billy Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/lp/75-day-devotional-day-12
Passage: Romans 13:11
Points:
- Scripture serves as a timely reminder that the present age is drawing to an end.
- Salvation is closer today than before, making spiritual alertness urgent.
- Human life passes quickly, so even the young must recognize its brevity.
- Believers must wake up, cast off darkness, and live uprightly.
- Christians have limited time left to witness for Christ and should act without delay.

### Salvation Draws Near
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/salvation-draws-near
Passage: Romans 13:11
Points:
- Human obedience cannot save us, because only Christ fulfilled the law perfectly.
- Biblical salvation encompasses past justification, ongoing sanctification, and final glorification.
- Each passing day brings Christians closer to the return of Jesus and the defeat of sin.
- Believers can take confidence that God will finish the redeeming work He began in them.
